user_saw: After permanently denying a permission, tapping its row again during Android setup offered no way to open Android Settings.
summary: The fix simplifies Android setup to four primary optional permissions, offers the Android Settings recovery dialog after permanent denial, and refreshes permission rows on return.
reasoning: The setup callback already updated grant state without offering Settings recovery at the oldest locally inspectable revision, and PR #98752 carried that callback forward. The path history stops at the shallow boundary, so I could not verify when the callback was introduced or whether an earlier implementation supported recovery.
